 Unbeaten James Madison puts its perfect record on the line today with a Sun Belt road matchup against Appalachian State . The Dukes are 7-0 overall and 4-0 in conference play, while the Mountaineers enter at 4-2 after a 35-32 win over Coastal Carolina. The kick is scheduled for 4 p.m. PT/7 p.m. ET (5 p.m. MST) on Thursday, October 22, and is broadcast on ESPNU and is streaming live on ESPN Unlimited .
